description: Connector-owned UI in the chat. Linear first: issue, list, board, project and create cards in Linear's own shape. One tool call per ask; the plugin reads Linear itself and Jev picks the view and fields at runtime.

skills.description: Show, triage, or create Linear issues through Linear-shaped cards in the chat. One tool call with the person's words; the plugin reads Linear and Jev picks the view. Use for 'show NEAT-9', 'what's open', 'where do we stand', 'create an issue for', 'file this in Linear'.

tools.description: Show one Linear issue as Linear's own issue view. Pass only the identifier; the plugin reads the issue and the team's pick lists itself.

Draft a new Linear issue as Linear's create dialog. Pass the person's words and a short title; the plugin reads the pick lists and Jev picks status, priority, project, labels and assignee. The person edits and presses Create issue.
Show Linear issues as Linear's own UI. Pass the person's words; the plugin reads Linear and Jev picks the view (issue, list, board, project), scope and fields.

purposes: Read issues, states, labels, projects and members from the connected Linear workspace to draw the cards. Never writes.
